title.text: Outside London, more productive regions churn only slightly more
subtitle: Reallocation rate against real GVA per hour, ITL2 regions outside London, pooled over each period. Dot size = employment; line = linear fit.
Dotted lines = average of all regions outside London (values under each period). Real GVA per hour in 2022 prices (ONS chained-volume). Northern Ireland excluded in 2004–10.
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS Subregional productivity (June 2025); authors' calculations.
